meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装好后,Linear 工单(issue)下的每条评论都会自动触发助手回复,无需 @ 它;同一个工单的评论串是一个独立会话,助手会在里面持续回应。
howto.when: 当有人在你指定的 Linear 团队里的任一工单下发表评论时,助手会收到事件并自动回复,不需要 @ 它。

say.text: 帮我在 NanoClaw 里接入 Linear,让助手回复工单评论。
say.note: 会开始按技能步骤配置频道。

say.text: 把 Linear 的 ENG 团队接到我指定的助手,评论自动触发回复。
say.note: 需要你提供 agent 文件夹和团队 key。

say.text: 用 OAuth 应用身份接入 Linear,不要用个人 API key。
say.note: 这样助手不会过滤掉你自己的评论。

howto.what_en: After installation, every comment on a Linear issue automatically triggers the agent to reply, with no need to @-mention it; each issue's comment thread is an isolated conversation where the agent keeps responding.
howto.when_en: When someone comments on any issue in the Linear team you configured, the agent receives the event and replies automatically; no @-mention is needed.

say_en.text: Set up Linear in NanoClaw so the agent replies to issue comments.
say_en.note: Starts configuring the channel per the skill steps.

say_en.text: Wire the ENG Linear team to my agent and auto-reply to every comment.
say_en.note: You'll need to provide the agent folder and team key.

say_en.text: Use an OAuth app identity for Linear, not a personal API key.
say_en.note: So the agent won't filter out your own comments.
